protocol.profile: Preserve the frozen formal model profile; public-train prefix only
protocol.fit_dates: All public train dates after the preserved profile prefix
protocol.model: LGB 400/63, same version-2 features; public train labels only
protocol.neural_architecture_selection: Not selected here. Future architecture/alpha must come from sealed development studies.
protocol.inference_scope: Offline State only; no future information supplied to Queue

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Production preparation reuses all public train labels, including earlier development assessments. No holdout score is claimed. Neural grid targets average colocated stations; scoring retains station-level truth.
